title: Zero-density excess does not change approximate tangent spaces (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2), pointwise form)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let A ⊆ B ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel sets, x ∈ ℝ^P and r₀ > 0 with H^n(B ∩ B̄_{r₀}(x)) < ∞, where H^n := μHE[n]. Suppose (†) H^n((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) / (ENNReal.ofReal ρ)^n → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0 in 𝓝[>] 0, the quotient taken in [0, ∞] (a/b = a·b⁻¹). Then for every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P, B has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q, Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4) if and only if A has approximate tangent space Q at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → 0 < r₀ → μHE[n] (B ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] ((B \ A) ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q
